summary: tailwindcss-contact-form ships an obfuscated import-time dropper impersonating tailwindcss-forms
details: The package impersonates the official @tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms plugin: package.json sets author.name to "@tailwindcss" and repository to https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms, while src/index.js prepends a ~50KB obfuscator.io-packed payload executed via eval(atob(...)) at the top of the module. The decoded payload loads node:http/node:https/node:child_process, retrieves attacker-controlled data from Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoints (public.blockscout-style hosts, h.drpc.org, publicnode.com) and an etherscan-like API used as a dead-drop channel, then spawns `node` with code piped into stdin via the `[eval]` mechanism to execute arbitrary attacker-supplied JavaScript on the installer's machine. The benign tailwindcss-forms plugin code is retained below the loader as cover. The dropper fires on any require() of the package, so any build or application that imports it executes attacker-controlled code at import time with the privileges of the Node process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
